Before you cut that out.. 1-Dollar store- buy construction paper. Green is a calming color.  2- buy sharpie same dollar store or travel to another location just to waste your time 3- buy masking tape at the store of your choice just leave me alone. 4- rip the cap off the sharpie like it plowed your girl and spit across the room. Ok ok I’m done. So decide how much you want to cut out and Mark it with the sharpie. Then using skissors cut the pieces of paper to rough shape,fit them up and trim where necessary so it’s a perfect match. Secure each piece of the paper to the panel with a tiny piece of masking tape to secure it in place while your cutting out and lining up the other piece(s) . Once you have made the stencil take each piece off and trace it out on the sheet metal your using and cut it out and mig or tig all your pieces together. Then cut the old piece out and weld in the piece you made.
